description:
A querent's number read as a sign. `system` navamsa108 (default): 1-108 as the navamsas from 0 Aries, the sign and its navamsa. ashtamangala: the three-digit Prasna Marga number (digits 1-8) with each digit's planet and parity and the tithi, nakshatra, weekday, rasi and bhuta from its remainders. Numbers above 108 point at /vedic/kp/horary (KP 1-249).

[Group: Vedic]
[Endpoint: POST /v1/vedic/prashna/number]
[Required: number]
[Cost: 10 credits (Tier 1)]

system.description: navamsa108 (default): a number 1-108 read as the navamsas of the zodiac from 0 Aries. ashtamangala: the three-digit Prasna Marga number, each digit 1-8. KP numbers 1-249 are /v1/vedic/kp/horary.
